_comment: AI radar source catalog. Deliberately small: fewer sources means a smaller triage context and lower token cost per run. Two tiers. PRIMARY, chosen by the user: labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), the people building them, investors, and NVIDIA. SUPPORTING press, engineering and research, added because the primary tier cannot report on itself -- the labs announce but do not analyse, the people publish on X which has no fetchable feed, and the VC firms blog about portfolio companies rather than deals. Fields: id, name, feed (RSS/Atom; null when the source publishes none - read 'site' with WebFetch), site, lang (also decides the card's language), category, weight (1-5). Optional: topic_filter, max_items, kind, note. Validated against the live network on 2026-09-03. Do NOT add github.com releases.atom feeds: the cloud sandbox scopes GitHub access to the cloned repository and returns 403 for every other repo.

sources.name: Anthropic News
sources.note: No public RSS (11 paths checked 2026-09-03, all 404). Read via the sitemap, which carries /news/ URLs with lastmod dates. Titles come from the URL slug and have no summary, so read the page before writing a card.

sources.name: Andrej Karpathy
sources.note: Posts far more often on X, which has no fetchable feed. This blog is low volume.

sources.name: Boris Cherny
sources.note: Claude Code. Low volume; most output is on X, which cannot be fetched.

sources.name: Thariq Shihipar
sources.note: Claude Code. Low volume; most output is on X, which cannot be fetched.

sources.name: The Batch (Andrew Ng / DeepLearning.AI)
sources.note: Andrew Ng's weekly letter plus DeepLearning.AI's news roundup. No RSS (/feed/, /rss.xml and /the-batch/rss.xml all 404 on 2026-09-03); read via the sitemap, which carries full timestamps. andrewng.org is not a separate source: it publishes no feed and no sitemap, and the letters land here. Titles come from the URL slug and have no summary, so read the page before writing a card.

sources.name: Sam Altman
sources.note: Personal blog. Rare but high-signal; his frequent posting is on X.

sources.name: Andreessen Horowitz
sources.note: No RSS at any conventional path (checked 2026-09-03). Read via post-sitemap.xml, which carries lastmod dates. Titles come from the URL slug and have no summary.

sources.name: NVIDIA Blog
sources.note: NVIDIA's own name is a topic keyword, so the global filter passes everything. The exclusion drops its gaming beat, which is most of the feed.

sources.name: NVIDIA Newsroom
sources.note: NVIDIA's own name is a topic keyword, so the global filter passes everything. The exclusion drops its gaming beat, which is most of the feed.

sources.name: TechCrunch AI
sources.note: Carries the funding, valuation and M&A news the VC blogs do not.

sources.name: The Decoder
sources.note: Highest signal per item. Reports what the lab founders say, which their own feeds do not.

sources.name: Ars Technica AI
sources.note: Depth and scepticism; strongest on legal and policy.

sources.name: Latent Space
sources.note: Agentic coding coverage. Editorial stand-in for the GitHub release feeds, which the cloud sandbox blocks.

sources.name: GitHub Changelog
sources.note: Covers all of GitHub, so it needs a gate. Uses its own vocabulary: the global filter dropped 'Enterprise-managed settings support any default model', a real Copilot governance change.
